title: assessment.v1
description: FROZEN CONTRACT — do not edit without conductor approval. One responder's independent assessment of one incident. TRANSPORT: unicast DM (Cotal `to: coordinator`) — NEVER broadcast, never published on sec.incident. Responders have allowPublish [] on sec.incident, so no responder can observe another responder's verdict; independence is enforced mechanically by the ACL, not by convention. Exactly one assessment per responder per incident_id; a late duplicate is dropped by the coordinator. `rationale` is hard-capped at 400 characters — it is a justification, not a transcript.

x-contract.transport: Cotal to:coordinator (unicast, at-least-once) — never a channel

responder.description: Canonical responder id. One of: responder_claude, responder_codex, responder_antigravity, responder_kimi, responder_glm.

model.description: EFFECTIVE model id that produced this assessment, as an OpenRouter id (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5). Must match the model_effective on this agent's effort receipt.

effort_requested.description: Reasoning effort the harness asked for.

effort_effective.description: Reasoning effort actually in force, read back from the runtime. If this differs from effort_requested the run is a downgrade and must be reported, never silently accepted.

verdict.description: This responder's independent verdict. The coordinator counts these deterministically; it does not re-judge them.

confidence.description: Responder's confidence in its own verdict.

campaign_stages.description: Which of the ten authorized-scenario attack steps this responder believes are present (1..10, same numbering as incident.v1.stage_signatures).

recommended_actions.description: Containment this responder proposes. Advisory only — the coordinator, not the responder, decides. An action reaches the decision's action_set only if at least two responders propose it independently.

action.description: One of the ten containment kinds. Closed enum — the containment executor implements exactly these and nothing else. Enum is frozen and MUST match contracts/containment.contract.jac. Any change requires conductor approval.

target.description: What the action applies to. Keys must be drawn from the incident's join_keys (or name a concrete app resource for feature/queue/credential actions). At least one key is required — an untargeted containment action is invalid.

src_ips.description: Source addresses to rate-limit or block.

credential_id.description: Synthetic service credential identifier for rotate_service_credential.

integration.description: Integration / service-API identifier when the action scopes to one integration.

ttl_s.description: Seconds the action stays in force before it automatically reverts. Every action is time-bounded; there is no permanent containment.

blast_radius.description: Estimated impact on legitimate users. Ordered narrow < moderate < broad; the coordinator caps each surviving action at the MINIMUM (narrowest) value any proposer offered.

skills_used.description: Cybersecurity skills this responder actually loaded, pinned by content hash so a run is reproducible and auditable.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the skill file that was loaded.

sha.description: Content hash of that exact file at load time.

rationale.description: Why this verdict. HARD CAP 400 characters — truncate, do not spill into other fields.

usage.description: Token and cost accounting for producing this single assessment.

reasoning.description: Reasoning tokens consumed. 0 when the runtime does not report them.

usd.description: Estimated USD cost, computed from contracts/mesh/prices.json.
